_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 3% of recent 12h windows moved ±2 and FLAT rule is active—no funding/ETF/macro impulse inside 24h—so coil HOLD is the honest base-rate call inside the Denial band.
next_move.brains_agree: yes — both hold Denial as current/forward phase with no directional break claimed
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 30-40 and BTC stays inside ~1.5% with no funding or ETF-flow impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: A >2.3% impulse with F&G breaking below 25 (Panic) or reclaiming above 46 on positive ETF flows (Anxiety)
